name: Medio Gen
description: Generate and edit images via a Grok or OpenAI-compatible gateway; Grok also supports video.
whenToUse: Use me to generate or edit images, or to generate videos / image-to-video.

grok_status.description: Check Medio Gen configuration: Base URLs, whether keys are saved, selected models, and cached model lists. Does not call a gateway unless refresh is true.

/properties/refresh.description: If true, GET /v1/models on each channel that already has an API key.

refresh_models.description: GET /v1/models from the chosen channel, store the list in plugin settings, and return it. openai is image-only.

/properties/provider.description: grok = Grok channel; openai = OpenAI channel.

gen_image.description: Text-to-image. Uses the default image provider from settings unless provider/model is set. OpenAI does not support video. Pass the user’s prompt unchanged.

/properties/prompt.description: Image description. Pass the user’s words unchanged.

/properties/provider.description: Only when the user named a channel. grok or openai.

/properties/model.description: Only when the user named a model in this chat.

/properties/aspect_ratio.description: Only when the user asked for a specific aspect ratio.

/properties/size.description: OpenAI channel only. Pass when the user asks for exact pixel dimensions, as WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 1920x1088; overrides aspect_ratio. gpt-image-2 models accept any size where both edges are multiples of 16, the longest edge is at most 3840, the edge ratio is at most 3:1, and total pixels are 655,360 to 8,294,400; above 2560x1440 is experimental. If the requested size breaks a rule, round to the nearest valid one and say so. Older models only take 1024x1024 / 1536x1024 / 1024x1536.

/properties/quality.description: OpenAI channel only. Pass when the user asks for a quality or speed level. xhigh and max are gpt-image-2.5 only.

/properties/background.description: OpenAI channel only. Pass transparent for cutouts, stickers or icons, together with output_format png or webp.

/properties/output_format.description: OpenAI channel only. Pass when the user asks for a file format; default png. jpeg has no transparency.

edit_image.description: Edit an image. Pass source images as ghost_call attachments or cindy-media:// URLs. Channel rules match gen_image.

/properties/prompt.description: How to edit. Pass the user’s words unchanged.

/properties/images.description: Optional cindy-media:// URLs. If the user attached images, leave this empty.

/properties/provider.description: Only when the user named a channel.

/properties/model.description: Only when the user named a model.

/properties/aspect_ratio.description: Only when the user asked for a specific aspect ratio.

/properties/size.description: OpenAI channel only. Pass when the user asks for exact pixel dimensions, as WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 1920x1088; overrides aspect_ratio. gpt-image-2 models accept any size where both edges are multiples of 16, the longest edge is at most 3840, the edge ratio is at most 3:1, and total pixels are 655,360 to 8,294,400; above 2560x1440 is experimental. If the requested size breaks a rule, round to the nearest valid one and say so. Older models only take 1024x1024 / 1536x1024 / 1024x1536.

/properties/quality.description: OpenAI channel only. Pass when the user asks for a quality or speed level. xhigh and max are gpt-image-2.5 only.

/properties/background.description: OpenAI channel only. Pass transparent for cutouts, stickers or icons, together with output_format png or webp.

/properties/output_format.description: OpenAI channel only. Pass when the user asks for a file format; default png. jpeg has no transparency.

gen_video.description: Text-to-video via the Grok channel only. OpenAI does not support video.

/properties/prompt.description: Video description. Pass the user’s words unchanged.

/properties/model.description: Only when the user named a model.

/properties/aspect_ratio.description: Only when the user asked for a specific aspect ratio.

/properties/duration.description: Seconds, max 15. Only when the user asked for a duration. Default 6.

/properties/resolution.description: Only when the user asked for a resolution. Default 720p.

edit_video.description: Image-to-video via the Grok channel only. One image is the first frame; two images are first and last frames.

/properties/prompt.description: How the image should move. Pass the user’s words unchanged.

/properties/model.description: Only when the user named a model.

/properties/aspect_ratio.description: Only when the user asked for a specific aspect ratio.

/properties/duration.description: Seconds, max 15. Only when the user asked for a duration. Default 6.

/properties/resolution.description: Only when the user asked for a resolution. Default 720p.
